text: Implemented on work/claude-w01: found and fixed a real-backend gap. RealPreview forwarded eyes4s's PlanError.MatchedCardinality (code plan.matched-cardinality, TrialDigest loci, no affected keys), so Studio could not present or open it. It now emits the keyed StudyFinding values eyes4s's own preflight builds from the cardinality (MatchItemConflict, MatchedCardinality, AmbiguousReferences). NativeExecutionSafetySuite 'two matched references under RequireOne are eyes4s's blocking finding' (P1 item 1 encoded as enc_1 and enc_9): study-finding.matched-cardinality at Error naming ret_1/enc_1/enc_9; DiagnosticsPresenter blocker with remedy opening exactly those trials. Note: eyes4s refuses one trial label at two occurrences (InventoryRefused), so the board's 'enc_04 at occurrences 1 and 2' cannot be admitted; two trial labels for one item is the admissible equivalent.
